category_name: Supplication of the traveller for the resident
title: Supplication of the traveller for the resident - Hisn al-Muslim 100
arabic: أَسْتَـوْدِعُكُـمُ اللَّهَ الَّـذي لا تَضـيعُ وَدائِعُـه
translation: I place you in the trust of Allah, whose trust is never misplaced.
reference: Ahmad 2/403, Ibn Majah 2/943. See also Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah 2/133.
